story_title: A Busy Evening at the Restaurant
task_instruction: Rewrite each affirmative statement as a negative question.
paragraphs: Mia works at a fictional KFC restaurant near the station. Her shift starts at five. {{red:Mia is usually at the counter by 4:50.}} {{mask_1}}? The first customers arrive soon after she begins.

{{red:The dining room is busy on Friday evenings.}} {{mask_2}}? Mia checks the tables while her coworker Ben prepares the counter. {{red:Ben has his name badge on.}} {{mask_3}}? He smiles and says he has checked it twice.

At six, a family comes in. {{red:The parents are waiting near the menu.}} {{mask_4}}? Mia greets them and shows them where to order. {{red:They have enough time before the movie.}} {{mask_5}}? Their movie starts at eight. {{red:The cashier is helping another customer.}} {{mask_6}}? Mia asks the family to wait a moment.

Ben carries a tray to a table. {{red:He does this carefully.}} {{mask_7}}? A little later, Mia checks the kitchen list. {{red:The kitchen team has the order ready.}} {{mask_8}}? The cook says it will be ready in a moment. {{red:The family has a coupon for dinner.}} {{mask_9}}? Mia checks the details before applying it.

A new customer looks at the drinks menu. {{red:She knows what she wants.}} {{mask_10}}? Mia answers her question and points to the choices. {{red:The customer is happy with the explanation.}} {{mask_11}}? She thanks Mia and places her order. {{red:The drinks are cold and ready.}} {{mask_12}}? Ben checks the cooler before serving them.

Near the end of the shift, the manager reviews the closing tasks. {{red:Mia has finished her counter list.}} {{mask_13}}? {{red:Ben is ready to clean the tables.}} {{mask_14}}? {{red:Ben has a short break before closing.}} {{mask_15}}? He drinks some water and returns to work. {{red:The manager does the weekly schedule.}} {{mask_16}}? She checks next week's staff availability.

{{red:The dining room is clean now.}} {{mask_17}}? The team has wiped the tables and swept the floor. {{red:The team has enough napkins for tomorrow.}} {{mask_18}}? The manager checks the storage shelf. {{red:Mia remembers the closing code.}} {{mask_19}}? She enters it after the manager locks the office. {{red:The front door is locked.}} {{mask_20}}? Ben checks it before they leave.
